scope: independent review of no-tools school CLI design critique

corrections.reason: dprime=d+e is a real-arithmetic identity. Direct field construction versus Gram-derived statistics audits numerical consistency, not physical correctness or a new independent transfer solve. Frozen tolerances remain required.

Only T(AP)=AF and T(AF)=AM, and H analogues, were evaluated. T(AM) is not supplied or needed. Defects at P/F need T(P),T(F), not T(H-A). Radiation defects are defined independently of whether material feedback was evaluated on M.

A six-original-field Gram is neither necessary nor an independent physical sample. Direct d/e/dprime reductions use separate arithmetic paths from five-basis Gram-derived values. Both consume the same audited six fields; their limited independence is explicit.

Record difference/cancellation scales, arithmetic order and actual longdouble nmant. Decimal80 decimal digits is independent aggregation of exported small statistics, not equal precision or identical rounding to longdouble and not a reconstruction of original fields.
Streaming memory accounting, measured bounded I/O check and hard stop behavior must be tested before a run. No runtime success/throughput is promised from metadata.
Freeze PSD/Cauchy rejection tolerances, never silently repair eigenvalues; null for undefined ratios. Coordinate/measure limitations retained.
Finite sampled direction statistics cannot establish spectrum, strict error bound, ETA, unique/true solution.

decision: design scope coherent after independent correction; implementation/tolerances/tests/preflight incomplete; no submission
